purpose: Behavioral replay inputs for model-proposal.md. These model IDs, observations, prices, scores, and URLs are fictional. Treat catalogs and source records as supplied host/tool responses; do not use live services or dispatch workers. Give an evaluator only shared_inputs and each case's input, then judge its answer against checks separately.

pricing.billing: uncached synchronous public API list prices, same context tier; user's actual billing unknown

cases.name: adequate-value-and-stronger-alternative

input.request: Rename the same option in three modules and update callers. Suggest models before dispatch.
input.acceptance: Existing CLI integration checks cover every affected caller.
input.fit_evidence: Operator's recorded trial of the identical migration pattern passed all acceptance checks with standard/high and premium/high; tiny/medium repeatedly missed callers. No trial compared other efforts.

checks: Recommend standard/high as Best value and Lowest cost in one row; tiny's cheaper price does not make it adequate.
Keep premium/high selectable as Highest capability; do not select premium/max or attach high-effort scores to max.
Show USD per million input/output tokens, both source URLs/dates, and public-list-price billing limitation; await a choice.

cases.name: crossed-prices-no-token-mix

input.request: Suggest models for the same caller migration; input/output token volume cannot yet be estimated.
input.fit_evidence: Standard/high and premium/high passed the identical migration checks; tiny failed.

checks: Expose the crossed input/output tradeoff without a Lowest cost winner or invented token mix.
Keep capability alternative available and qualify any value recommendation as lacking cost ordering.

cases.name: missing-pricing

input.request: Suggest models for the same caller migration.
input.fit_evidence: Standard/high and premium/high passed; tiny failed.
input.pricing_unavailable: Provider pricing and ranking cost fields cannot be retrieved; no usable cache exists.

checks: Mark prices unknown and avoid Best value and Lowest cost labels.
Offer standard/high and premium/high as adequate alternatives without inventing rates, comparing unknown cost, or recommending one unconditionally.

cases.name: no-capability-evidence

input.request: Suggest models for a parser cleanup.
input.capability_unavailable: Ranking cannot be retrieved and cache has no scores; pricing remains available.

checks: List the launchable candidates unranked with their prices, explain the missing capability evidence, and recommend none.
Do not call price or family evidence of quality, or claim a measured value winner.

cases.name: explicit-choice

input.request: Use fixture-standard at medium effort for this unit and fixture-review at high for review, with a budget of 2, and proceed.

checks: Honor standard/medium without asking the user to choose again or increasing effort.
Pass the explicit implementation and review rows to caller resolution without reopening selection; do not claim the high-effort score measures medium.

cases.name: recommended-without-ranking
checks: With no capability evidence there is no recommendation to apply: list the launchable candidates unranked and ask the user to pick, rather than choosing one.

cases.name: input-output-cost-scenario

input.request: Suggest models for the same caller migration. Estimate using 100000 input and 10000 output tokens, excluding unknown extra reasoning tokens.
input.fit_evidence: Standard/high and premium/high passed the same checks; tiny failed.

checks: Compute standard's scenario cost as USD 0.40 and premium's as USD 0.85; identify standard as lowest cost among adequate candidates under that scenario.
Show both rates and the token assumptions; label the estimate a scenario rather than the user's bill and disclose excluded charges.
